[SWS_DM_01349] Consecutive registration of notifier with SetEventSta- tusChangedNotifier()
⌈
In case of a consecutive call of ara::diag::Event::-
SetEventStatusChangedNotifier of the corresponding ara::diag::Event in-
stance, DM module shall overwrite the previous registered notifier.
